decisions.reason: As a low-risk service complement to the installed base, it is likely retained because it fits existing capabilities and customer relationships and can be carried even with somewhat uncertain results unless performance clearly falls below aspiration.

This accessory builds on the firm's modular machinery business, so management would likely keep it as long as it performs near aspiration and uses existing engineering and sales resources efficiently.

Because it is distant from the firm's established offer, management is more likely to see any weak or ambiguous results as falling short of aspiration and to reallocate resources toward closer, better-understood product areas.

A high-speed CNC milling line is close to the core business and supported by strong in-house R&D, testing, and service capabilities, so the firm would usually continue it unless there were a clear and sustained performance shortfall.

The automatic tool change system directly supports the firm's productivity-oriented machinery offer, and its strong strategic fit and likely low incremental carrying cost make retention more likely than withdrawal.
